import random, sys, time, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import algo, para, fab, exact

def big_profile(rng, K=256, M=4096):
    x = [rng.randint(-10**6, 10**6) for _ in range(K)]
    nodes = list(range(K))
    meas = []
    for i in range(K-1):
        a, b = nodes[i], nodes[i+1]
        d = x[b]-x[a]
        meas.append([a,b,d-5,d+5])
    for _ in range(M-(K-1)):
        a, b = rng.randrange(K), rng.randrange(K)
        d = x[b]-x[a]
        L = d - rng.randint(0,10); U = d + rng.randint(0,10)
        meas.append([a,b,L,U])
    rng.shuffle(meas)
    jit = [rng.randint(0,10**6) for _ in range(K)]
    return {"groups":K,"jitter_ps":jit,"measurements":meas}, x

def big_fabric(rng, N=512, P=512, Q=8, per_slice=None, nguards=8):
    # choose T,S: want P = QS/gcd(T,QS) = P.  QS = P*S'... pick S=64, T=64: mod=Q*64, gcd=64 -> P=Q
    # need P=512 with Q=8: mod/gcd(T,mod)=512: mod=Q*S: pick S=4096, mod=32768, T=64: gcd=64, P=512 ✓
    S = 4096; T = 64; O = rng.randrange(S)
    Qn = Q
    L = 16384
    links = []
    K = 4
    used_ports = {}
    for l in range(L):
        a = rng.randrange(N); b = rng.randrange(N)
        while b == a: b = rng.randrange(N)
        sa = rng.randrange(32); sb = rng.randrange(32)
        ga = rng.randrange(K); gb = rng.randrange(K)
        links.append({"ends":[[a,sa,ga],[b,sb,gb]],
                      "delay_ns":[rng.randint(1,8*T),rng.randint(1,8*T)],
                      "defer_rounds":[rng.randint(0,8),rng.randint(0,8)]})
    if per_slice is None: per_slice = 1024
    slices = []
    for s in range(Qn):
        ids = rng.sample(range(L), per_slice)
        slices.append(ids)
    heat = []
    for _ in range(2048):
        nd = rng.randrange(N); st = rng.randrange(P); en = rng.randint(st+1,P+1)
        heat.append([nd,st,en,rng.randint(0,10**6)])
    anchors = [[rng.randrange(N), rng.randrange(P), P] for _ in range(64)]
    anchors += [[0,0,P]]
    bl = []
    for _ in range(2048):
        l = rng.randrange(L); st = rng.randrange(P); en = rng.randint(st+1,P+1)
        bl.append([l,st,en])
    guards = sorted(rng.sample(range(0,(S-1)//2), nguards))
    return {"n":N,"interval_ns":T,"slice_ns":S,"offset_ns":O,
            "drift_ppb":[rng.randint(0,10**6) for _ in range(N)],
            "heat":heat,"anchors":anchors,"links":links,"slices":slices,
            "blackouts":bl,"guards_ns":guards,"reconfig_ns":rng.randint(0,10**9)}, x

if __name__ == '__main__':
    rng = random.Random(7)
    mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'plan'
    t0 = time.time()
    prof, x = big_profile(rng)
    print('profile built %.1fs' % (time.time()-t0), flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    art = para.calibrate(prof)
    print('calibrate %.1fs status=%s' % (time.time()-t0, art['status']), flush=True)
    if mode == 'calib':
        sys.exit()
    t0 = time.time()
    fabric, x = big_fabric(rng)
    print('fabric built %.1fs' % (time.time()-t0), flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    plan = algo.compile_plan(prof, fabric)
    print('plan %.1fs guard=%s peaks=%s warmup=%s' % (time.time()-t0, plan['guard_ns'], plan['peaks_as'][:2], plan['warmup_cycle']), flush=True)
    if mode == 'audit':
        t0 = time.time()
        r = algo.audit(prof, fabric, plan)
        print('audit %.1fs %s' % (time.time()-t0, r), flush=True)
EOF
